newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH MINISTRY ISSUES NEW INTL PHONE TARRIFS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH MINISTRY ISSUES NEW INTL PHONE TARRIFS.

text.p: The Czech Transportation and
Communication Ministry on Wednesday issued new prices for
international phone-calls, effective April 1, 1997.
As of April 1, the price per impulse rises from two to 2.25
crowns if the phone call is conducted from a fixed line and to
three crowns from telephone booths, the ministry, which is
reponsible for the tarrifs, said in a statement.
But the ministry also said it had lengthened impulses,
which vary depending on the destination of the call, thus
bringing prices down by an average of 0.6 percent.
SPT Telecom a.s. , the country's dominant telephone
operator was not immediately available for comment.
Examples of tarrif changes in Czech crowns for a six minute
call from a hard line as released by the Ministry.

tarrifs for international phone calls. Tarrifs for domestic
calls belong to the responsility of the Finance Minsitry.
